final: WITH group_sums AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS game_difference FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(game_difference) AS average_difference FROM group_sums) SELECT SUM(g.game_difference) AS total_difference, AVG(g.game_difference - o.average_difference) AS average_excess FROM group_sums AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.average_difference IS NOT NULL WHERE g.game_difference > o.average_difference
